worktree.setup:
git config core.hooksPath .githooks
[ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/config.yaml" ] && cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/config.yaml" config.yaml || true
[ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env" ] && cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env" .env || true
mkdir -p .serena .claude/skills
[ -d "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.serena/memories" ] && ln -sfn "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.serena/memories" .serena/memories || true
[ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.serena/project.yml" ] && ln -sfn "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.serena/project.yml" .serena/project.yml || true
[ -d "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.claude/skills/gitnexus" ] && ln -sfn "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.claude/skills/gitnexus" .claude/skills/gitnexus || true
cargo fetch --locked
worktree.teardown: sh -lc 'name=$(echo "$PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH" | sed "s|^/||; s|/|-|g"); codebase-memory-mcp cli delete_project --project "$name" >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f ~/.cache/codebase-memory-mcp/"$name".db*' || true

ci.command: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo check --all-targets --locked && cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo test --locked && python3 scripts/check_code_size.py

serve.command: cargo run --bin lite -- serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PASEO_PORT --config $([ -f config.yaml ] && echo config.yaml || echo config.yaml.example)
